'''Larook''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] with a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] personality who was the leader of the [[Bareesh]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Though once one of the leading Hutt clans, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of Larook's reign the kajidic had declined in power and sought to return to prominance once more. To that end, Larook aggressively involved himself and the Bareesh in Hutt politics, much to the ire of the more influential Hutt clans.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
